# Capsule + Relic Sequence compatibility fixtures

These fixtures are semantic/runtime-authority roles, not hard-coded base-game ordinals. Concrete relic identities and rarity lanes must be chosen from the captured runtime authority when the fixture runs.

- **A SameFact redundant** — Capsule observed/proven Initial lane position `#1=A`; explicit Relic Queue requires the same `#1=A`. Expect legal shared block, probability paid once, full R replay allowed physically.
- **B Direct conflict** — same Capsule-proven initial position conflicts with explicit `#1=B`/Ban A. Expect joint probability zero / impossible and no fabricated independent product.
- **C Large Capsule + residual queue** — Capsule path proves early initial positions while explicit queue repeats them and constrains later positions. Expect exact joint and exact downstream `P(N∩R)/P(N)`. Physical predicate elimination is optional; current closeout retains full R replay unless proof is route-universal.
- **D Non-overlapping later positions** — Capsule constrains early Initial RelicGrabBag facts, explicit Relic Queue constrains later positions. Expect legal shared block and no blanket Capsule+R rejection.
- **E Direct Small Capsule + Relic Sequence** — exact shared probability/search semantics. Direct Capsule GPU resident scratch topology is not fabricated; legal CPU/GPU-root+CPU alternatives remain allowed.
- **F Direct Large Capsule + Relic Sequence** — same as E with two-draw runtime-authority Capsule behavior.
- **G Bones + Small Capsule + Relic Sequence** — PreBones resident Capsule scratch is producer-internal; N→R may bind when current GPU semantic projection is complete.
- **H Bones + Large Capsule + Relic Sequence** — same as G, including Large Capsule two-pull/fallback authority.
- **I Bones + Large + Small Capsule + Relic Sequence** — Offered/Reverse route-local Capsule bag mutation remains route-local inside Stage2. ABI1 carries no route mask; downstream R therefore replays the full explicit Initial RelicGrabBag predicates rather than unsafe route-specific residual elimination.
- **J Capsule absent** — ordinary Relic Sequence probability/search behavior is unchanged.

All runtime fixtures require Production Exact + SameRoute Witness and Whole Recovery Batch fallback semantics. No fixture may reinterpret UI positions as post-Capsule positions.
